headline: NEPSE closes higher moderately at 2,591.81 as banking and hotels & tourism lead
body: The NEPSE index closed at 2,591.81 (+17.15 points, +0.67%). Bulls were in control as advancers outnumbered decliners (220 vs 119). Strength came from Banking and Hotels & Tourism shares (up 1.28%). Day range: 2,569.09 – 2,591.85.
All figures above are the official session close. Quotes refresh during market hours; outside hours the last close is shown.
